changes_made.explanation: Consolidated tasks to single descriptive entry, removed duplicate/redundant task and output descriptions, added full dataset name for clarity
Normalized capitalization of 'Accuracy', kept all other specialized metrics as they are custom evaluation metrics developed for this specific paper
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper; the LLMs were used for generation only, not for post-generation evaluation
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper; all evaluations were automated using the proposed metrics

overall_notes: This paper focuses on analyzing the internal factual recall mechanisms of LLMs during reasoning tasks rather than traditional NLG evaluation. The evaluation metrics (KN Scores, ER, SR) are custom metrics developed specifically for this study to measure internal knowledge activation rather than standard NLG quality metrics. The paper uses factual question answering as the generation task to study underlying mechanisms.
